data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one clean HD 2D game animation sprite sheet, 1024x1024, with exactly four equal invisible cells arranged 2 rows x 2 columns. Background must be solid flat chroma magenta #FF00FF across the entire image including spacing between frames. No visible grid lines, no borders, no boxes, no guide marks, no labels, no text, no UI, no watermark.

Use the supplied nautilus avatar only as visual style reference for palette/material language: electric cyan, turquoise, deep ocean blue, violet shell highlights, glossy underwater glow, pearl bubbles, clean polished hand-painted game-sprite rendering. Do NOT draw Romi, no body, no character silhouette, no nautilus creature, no eyes, no face, no tentacles, no fins, no full shell body, no card UI, no weapon, no hand. Pure attack FX asset only.

Each of the four frames must be centered in its cell with same visual scale and similar bounding box, generous magenta safe padding, nothing touching or crossing cell edges. The invisible cell centers are approximately (256,256), (768,256), (256,768), (768,768).

Attack FX concept: “spiral shell pressure burst,” a magical water-pressure attack released from an abstract nautilus spiral. Cute, bright, aquatic, readable at game size. Compact sequence from build-up to release to fade.

Top-left frame 1 wind-up: small bright cyan abstract nautilus spiral sigil at center, tight blue-violet water arcs curling inward, tiny pearl bubbles.
Top-right frame 2 charge: spiral brighter and denser, clockwise turquoise water ribbons wrapping around it, shell-like crescent highlights, bubbles compressing toward center.
Bottom-left frame 3 peak attack: compact aqua-white spiral burst opens outward like a shell-shaped water shockwave, violet rim light, short curved water slashes, sparkling droplets, strong readable spiral core.
Bottom-right frame 4 fade: burst dissolves into translucent blue-violet crescent afterimages, scattered pearl bubbles, faint circular ripple, same centered footprint.

Style: not pixel art, crisp readable silhouette, polished hand-painted glow, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, high-contrast cyan/blue/violet palette, transparent-looking glow elements but on solid #FF00FF background. Exactly four FX frames only.
